en: Black-and-white image of a small passenger steamer or excursion boat traveling along a calm lake or wide river, surrounded by dense coniferous and mixed forest on both shores under a cloudy sky. The boat is centered, moving toward the camera, with several people visible on deck. The scene evokes a northern European lake or archipelago landscape. No visible caption or border text appears on the image side.
